elements.element: Cap applies mutually to both parties
elements.evidence: "EACH PARTY'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED"

elements.element: Cap limb (a): fees paid or payable in the 12 months preceding the claim
elements.evidence: "IN THE TWELVE (12) MONTHS IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM" — anchored to an event, not to the claim as the position requires

elements.element: Cap limb (b): USD 1,000,000 floor, on a greater-of basis
elements.evidence: "THE GREATER OF (I) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE ... AND (II) USD 1,000,000"
"IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY BE LIABLE TO THE OTHER PARTY ... FOR ANY SPECIAL, INDIRECT, INCIDENTAL OR CONSEQUENTIAL DAMAGES"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for breach of confidentiality
elements.evidence: "EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S BREACH OF ITS CONFIDENTIALITY ... OBLIGATIONS"

elements.element: Uncapped carve-out for data protection and security obligations
Uncapped carve-out for gross negligence and wilful misconduct
Uncapped carve-out for infringement of the other party's IP
elements.evidence: "ITS INFRINGEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTY'S INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY RIGHTS"

elements.element: Customer's payment obligations are not "damages" for cap purposes
elements.evidence: "LICENSEE'S OBLIGATION TO PAY FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT CONSTITUTE DAMAGES" — limited to fees rather than all payment obligations/amounts due

elements.element: Mutual cap of 12 months' fees (fallback measure)
elements.evidence: Cap is "THE GREATER OF (I) THE FEES PAID OR PAYABLE ... AND (II) USD 1,000,000", not a 12-month fee cap; the fallback threshold is exceeded with the preferred-only amount

elements.element: Carve-out for gross negligence and wilful misconduct (fallback)

offending_extra_words: ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT
EACH PARTY'S AGGREGATE CUMULATIVE TOTAL LIABILITY ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT SHALL NOT EXCEED
reasons: Preferred cap limb (a) is anchored to "THE EVENT GIVING RISE TO THE CLAIM" rather than the required period "preceding the claim"; change the anchor to the claim.
The payment-obligation carve-out is narrowed to "FEES DUE UNDER THIS AGREEMENT"; the position requires that Customer's payment obligations (all amounts due) not be treated as capped damages.
Fallback is not independently satisfied because the cap is a greater-of including USD 1,000,000 rather than a 12-month fee cap; the two levels are separate bargains.

Minimality fails: operation 2 rewrites 26 words into 106 and also broadens the cap scope from "UNDER THIS AGREEMENT" to "ARISING OUT OF OR RELATING TO THIS AGREEMENT"; keep the original scope wording and place the Excluded Claims definition and payment-obligation sentence as a tighter separate insertion.
Unrelated commercial terms and paragraph (c) are untouched and the mutuality fix is a genuine improvement for us, so intent is preserved.
